from bookings import load_bookings, ROWS
from firsts import new_hotels

EXPECTED = list(dict.fromkeys(k for k, _ in ROWS))


def test_called_twice():
    data = list(load_bookings())
    new_hotels(data)
    assert new_hotels(data) == EXPECTED


def test_known_values_left_out():
    data = list(load_bookings())
    assert new_hotels(data, {EXPECTED[0]}) == EXPECTED[1:]
